stance_rationale: Judge's PASS_CONDITIONAL is not audit-clean: M4-specific incremental evidence fails Harvey/DSR, has zero lockbox deviation versus S2, and depends on unapproved AX/tail/artifact exceptions. The draft should be revised to a non-approval verdict until AX-001/AX-008, lockbox, and required artifact-path evidence are resolved.

scenario_rule_audit.replacement_evidence: request.json current_portfolio=STR_1715_100pct_pg2_core_alpha and Forge compares M4 against S1/S2 replacement baselines; this is not an additive Sequential Admission case.

statistical_robustness_audit.point_estimate_vs_robust_tradeoff: Raw M4 SR=1.6399 and CAPM alpha pass, but those are inherited baseline-level results. M4-specific incremental tests fail: M4-S1 t=-1.4952, M4-S2 t=0.8102, crisis M4-S2 t=1.0604; post-shopping incremental DSR is not validly cleared.

critical_concerns.description: Judge marks lockbox PASS, but recomputation shows 2024-01..2026-03 M4-S2 has 0 nonzero return months; the two lockbox cash months are identical to S2 baseline. OOS/IS=1.99 validates baseline exposure, not M4 incremental edge.

Gate G should be FAIL, not PARTIAL/PASS_CONDITIONAL: the two positive specs are raw/baseline-inherited, while all three M4-incremental specs fail and method-shopping n=145 is not cleared by a valid incremental DSR.

Forge ax001_v2.overall_pass=false, crisis_alpha passes only 2/8, and bad_normal_ratio=0.1317. Judge converts this into framework-reform neutrality, but AX-001 v2 is immutable until governance actually approves an exception.

Prior Codex alpha/risk/optimizer critiques raised REJECT/REVISE-class concerns that remain material: M4 as alpha rewrite, artifact path gaps, PIT lineage by assertion, CVaR waiver, and PG2 admission evidence. Judge treats rebuttals as validated too readily.

User-specified weights.csv at qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260430_001/weights.csv is absent, and qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260430_001/covariance.parquet is absent. The mailbox covariance is PSD cond=87.4604, but that does not satisfy the requested stage-artifact evidence path.

Stage alpha_validation.json still says mandate_pass_vs_s2=true, DSR n_trials=3, C1 rolling-only PASS, and C14/C15 N/A, while final packages concede candidate status, n_trials>=64/145, and unresolved lineage. Judge did not flag this artifact/package inconsistency.

Forge hard_caps.all_pass=false and cvar_d_pass=false with CVaR_95=-10.13% vs -10% cap. 'Mechanical inheritance' may explain the breach, but without an approved waiver it cannot support a PASS-style tail gate.

supporting_arguments: Mailbox covariance.parquet is symmetric PSD with min_eigenvalue=5.50538e-05 and condition_number=87.4604, so the covariance calculation itself is not the issue.
stage_artifacts alpha_scores.parquet has 267 monthly dates from 2004-01-01 to 2026-03-01, so RF-A7 single-snapshot risk is low, but it lacks a Ticker column and needs an explicit schema exception.
stage_artifacts/weights.csv has 267 rows, long-only weights, sum error about 1.1e-15, and overlay turnover below the 600% hard cap.
Forge integrity is strong at the mechanical level: realized SR 1.6399 equals optimizer estimate, and MDD 30.33% is below the 45% hurdle.

weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that PASS_CONDITIONAL can rest on baseline-inherited SR/CAPM strength and MDD protection even though M4-specific incremental alpha has no lockbox deviation versus S2 and fails Harvey/DSR after method-shopping.

Obtain formal AX-001 meta-allocation exception approval or mark Gate 5 AX FAIL.
Mirror or produce weights.csv and covariance.parquet at the exact requested paths, or document a formal path exception.

rationalization_red_flags: NEGLIGIBLE/negligible used for cost or divergence framing.
BY DESIGN/by design used to down-rank high TDC, HHI, and sleeve concentration concerns.
mechanical inheritance used to soften a hard tail-cap breach before waiver approval.
theoretical anchor / Conservative anchor preferred over data-max / avoid over-tuning used despite full-sample SR rising at stronger protection levels.
PASS_BY_LINEAGE used for PIT lineage without direct release-date/write-time proof.
No exact assertive hit of the Korean base-list phrases was found outside self-scan text, but English equivalents above remain active rationalization flags.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Forge validates mechanical replay, not independent M4 alpha discovery. The requested artifact paths, stale validation artifacts, failed incremental statistics, and unapproved AX/tail exceptions prevent two-source PASS under AX-008.
